title: UFO clippings: "Civil Defense Director Watches 'Flying Saucer'", Gallup poll, cartoons
description: Two-page spread of pasted 1960s newspaper clippings about UFO sightings, including the Oakland Tribune headline "Civil Defense Director Watches 'Flying Saucer'," "Who's in All Those Saucers?", "Eerie 1896 Sighting," "87 Coeds Observe 'Object'," "'I Know What I Saw'; Egg-Shaped Craft," a Gallup poll item "More Than 5 Million People Say They Saw Flying Saucers," and "UFO Plays Tag With Deputies in 85-Mile Chase." Visuals include portrait photos, a cartoon captioned "The swamp gas is restless tonight!", a cartoon of a saucer over a house, and a drawing of a flying saucer.
